# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 2

**1** Jesus said: "Let the one who seeks [шине] not cease [археі] seeking until [шантеч] he finds [хе].

**2** And when he finds [хе], he will be troubled [шнт].

**3** When he is troubled [шнт], he will marvel [шпнре].

**4** And he will reign [рро] over all [пτнрч]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *шине*: to seek, search; imperative-like force in this construction
- *археі* (negative): "not cease/stop"; the seeking must be relentless
- *шнт*: to be disturbed, troubled, thrown into confusion — not negative but a necessary stage
- *шпнре*: to be amazed, astonished, marvel; follows disturbance
- *рро*: to reign, become king; cf. P.Oxy 654 which adds a fifth stage: "and having reigned, he will rest [ἀναπαήσεται]"
- P.Oxy 654 (lines 5-9) preserves Greek version with five stages including rest; Coptic has four stages
- The four-stage progression: seek → find → be troubled → marvel → reign is a spiritual itinerary

---
